coordinate_system.y: positive downward in this KiCad 4 pcb file. ErgoDOX-Edge.Cuts.gm1 draws the same Edge.Cuts segments with G01 and with Y negated.
coordinate_system.rotation: Degrees, the optional third value of a module or pad (at x y rot). KiCad 4.0.7 RotatePoint maps a local point by x' = x*cos(rot) + y*sin(rot), y' = -x*sin(rot) + y*cos(rot). Board position is the module origin plus that vector.

not_counted_as_keys.reason: Top-actuated tactile reset switch, not a key switch.

edge_cuts.interpretation: Straight segments. The stored angle is 90 on every Edge.Cuts gr_line, but the endpoints chain into one closed loop and ErgoDOX-Edge.Cuts.gm1 contains only G01 linear moves (no G02/G03), with Y negated relative to this file.

usb.note: Footprint name USBMINImod. This is the USB connector on the board; it is not a USB-C footprint.

trrs.note: Schematic value is 3.5mm and the footprint is 4pin35mmAudio. A 4-pin 3.5 mm jack is the TRRS connector. The file does not use the word TRRS.

plate_comparison.summary: The 38 classic SW centers match the Litster Standard Right plate in a shared Y-up millimetre frame by translation only (no rotation, no mirror). The Standard Left plate cutouts are the mirror of the Right plate cutouts.
plate_comparison.frame: DXF coordinates are Y-up millimetres. KiCad file Y is downward; the Edge.Cuts gerber negates Y. Comparison uses y_up = -y_kicad.

right_plate.y_offset_from: Two right-plate circles of radius 1.524 mm share X with two H99 mounting holes. For both, y_circle + y_hole = 209.9818 mm. The same constant maps all 38 SW centers onto cutout centers.

left_plate_native_kicad_y_down.note: This proper 180 degree match uses KiCad's native Y-down numbers. Negating Y to the DXF's Y-up frame turns it into a mirror, so it is not a second non-mirrored match.

outline_vs_edge_cuts.note: Switch alignment does not make the plate outline follow Edge.Cuts. Distances are from polyline vertices to the other polyline.
